# Reporter Assay Pipeline
> Command-line toolkit for reporter-assay activity calling and cap-selection RNA endpoint bigWigs (0.1.0b4).

Software: [haiyuan-yu-lab/reporter-assay-pipeline](https://github.com/haiyuan-yu-lab/reporter-assay-pipeline).

## Docs
- [Home](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/): Reporter vs cap-selection paths
- [Quickstart](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/quickstart/): Install and verify executables
- [Tasks](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/tasks/): Task index
- [Workflow](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/workflow/): Reporter-assay nine-step graph
- [Cap-selection workflow](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/cap-selection/workflow/): Fork–join Steps 1–4 and bigWig deliverables
- [CLI overview](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/cli/): All four executables
- [Pipeline CLI](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/cli/pipe/): `yulab_reporter_pipe`
- [Cap-selection CLI](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/cli/cap-assay/): Step 4 options, filtering, BAM boundary, example
- [QC CLI](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/cli/qc/): Analytical plots
- [Export CLI](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/cli/export/): ExogeneousSequences export
- [Artifact formats](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/formats/): Tables and cap-selection `.5pl.bw` / summary JSON
- [FAQ](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/faq/): Symptoms and recovery
- [Known limitations](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/known-limitations/): Including cap-selection Step 4 scope
- [Glossary](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/glossary/): Cap signal, polymerase-position proxy, reporter terms
